note: Based on the genus-level monograph description of Roonwal & Chhotani (1989) (in English), itself recast from the original description of Bose 1984; the soldier and the pseudoworker are described and measured, while the alate is given in the original as Imago Unknown. Type specimens examined; type locality Salem, Tamil Nadu, India.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish, paler medially; postclypeus and labrum slightly darker; anteclypeus transparent; mandibles dark brown, reddish brown at the base; antenna pale golden yellow; thorax, legs and body creamy yellow. Head and body sparsely setose. Body length 9.8—11.5 mm. Head capsule subrectangular; width about three-quarters of the length or slightly less (length to mandible base 3.20—3.35, width 2.28—2.45 mm); sides nearly straight, slightly widening anteriorly near the antennae; posterior part rounded; Y-suture present and distinct; frons slightly depressed, sloping anteriorly at about 45°. Eyes translucent, oval (length 0.33—0.36 mm), about one short diameter from the antenna. Ocelli minute, white dots at the ends of the lateral arms of the Y-suture. Postclypeus flat, subrectangular, not clearly differentiated from the frons; anterior margin with one seta on each side and another pair medially. Anteclypeus thin, transparent, glabrous, band-like. Labrum broadly lingulate, the apex broadly rounded, with a few long and short setae near the anterior margin and on the surface. Antenna 12 segments; segment 3 longer than 2 and strongly sclerotised; segment 4 shortest. Mandibles short and thick, the outer margin weakly raised at the base, length 1.95—2.00 mm, slightly less than two-thirds of the head length (mandible length/head length index 0.60—0.62). Left mandible with 6 marginal teeth; right mandible with 2 large marginal teeth situated medially. Postmentum long, club-shaped; the club bilobed, anterior and posterior lobes equally wide; waist long and narrow, waist width less than half the club width; median length 2.25—2.45, club width 0.80—0.85, waist width 0.30—0.33 mm. Pronotum flat, subrectangular, almost as wide as the head (length 1.15—1.23, width 2.13—2.38 mm); anterior margin rather deeply incurved, sides rounded, posterior margin nearly straight with a slight median incurving. Mesonotum and metanotum semicircular; mesonotum narrower than the pronotum, metanotum slightly wider than the mesonotum but still narrower than the pronotum. Legs short and thick, sparsely setose; tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate-oval, densely setose; cerci 2-segmented, 0.10 mm long; styli single-segmented, long and narrow, 0.15 mm long.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head capsule creamy yellow; labrum slightly darker; body paler. Body length 5.10—7.00 mm. Head capsule subcircular, width slightly greater than the length to the mandible base (length 1.00—1.70, width 1.18—1.90 mm). Eyes fairly large, translucent, oval, long diameter about 0.25 mm. Postclypeus flat, sub-trapezoidal, not clearly differentiated from the frons, with a few short setae; anteclypeus transparent, glabrous. Labrum rounded-lingulate. Antenna 15—17 segments; segment 4 shortest; segment 2 longer than 3. Mandibles of the typical Neotermes type. Pronotum subrectangular, anterior margin weakly incurved, sides and posterior margin rounded (length 0.55—0.90, width 1.03—1.75 mm). Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
